blocks.prompt: 18 (i) On Defense Day, Teacher I prepares a list of 10 national songs, and Teacher II also prepares a separate list of 10 different national songs. The principal wants to select 3 songs from Teacher I's list and 3 songs from Teacher II's list. In how many ways can the songs be selected if: (i) The sequence of the selected songs matters
blocks.explanation:
Do alag choices hain: list I se 3 songs aur list II se 3 songs. "Sequence matters" ka matlab (jaisa kitab ke jawab mein liya gaya) yeh hai ke har list se liye gaye 3 songs ki tarteeb ahem hai.
Plan: \({}^{10}P_{3} \times {}^{10}P_{3}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 10 mukhtalif songs ki do lists; har list se 3 songs; tarteeb ahem.
Humein find karna hai: tareeqon ki tadaad.
Tareeqa: Har list se tarteeb ke saath, baghair dohraye 3 songs chunna \({}^{10}P_{3}\) hai. Dono choices saath hain, is liye multiply.

Ek list se tarteeb wali choices
\[{}^{10}P_{3} = 10 \times 9 \times 8\]
\[= 720\]
Kyun: Pehla song 10 mein se koi bhi, doosra baqi 9 mein se, teesra baqi 8 mein se. Pehle "Song A phir Song B" aur "Song B phir Song A" alag program hain, is liye permutation.

Dono lists ke liye multiply karein
\[720 \times 720 = 518400\]
Kyun: List I ki har tarteeb list II ki har tarteeb ke saath ja sakti hai.
Dhyan dein: \(720 + 720\) likhna ghalat hai, kyunke principal ko dono lists se songs lene hain ("and").

Tasdeeq
\[{}^{10}P_{3} = {}^{10}C_{3} \times 3! = 120 \times 6 = 720\]
\[720^{2} = 518400 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Har 3 songs ka group \(3! = 6\) tarteebon mein gaya ja sakta hai, is liye permutation combination ka 6 guna hai.

blocks.prompt: 18 (ii) On Defense Day, Teacher I prepares a list of 10 national songs, and Teacher II also prepares a separate list of 10 different national songs. The principal wants to select 3 songs from Teacher I's list and 3 songs from Teacher II's list. In how many ways can the songs be selected if: (ii) The sequence of the selected songs does not matter.
blocks.explanation:
Ab sirf yeh dekhna hai ke kaunse songs chune gaye, un ki tarteeb nahi.
Plan: \({}^{10}C_{3} \times {}^{10}C_{3}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 10 songs ki do lists; har list se 3; tarteeb ahem nahi.
Humein find karna hai: tareeqon ki tadaad.
Tareeqa: Har list se selection \({}^{10}C_{3}\); dono lists ke liye multiply.

Ek list se selections
\[{}^{10}C_{3} = \dfrac{10 \cdot 9 \cdot 8}{3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{720}{6} = 120\]
Kyun: Part (i) ke 720 mein har 3 songs ka group \(3! = 6\) dafa gina gaya tha. Tarteeb ki ahmiyat khatam hui to 6 se divide kiya.

Dono lists ke liye multiply karein
\[120 \times 120 = 14400\]
Kyun: List I ka har selection list II ke har selection ke saath ja sakta hai.
Dhyan dein: \({}^{20}C_{6}\) lagana ghalat hai; woh dono lists ko mila deta hai aur yeh shart khatam kar deta hai ke har list se theek 3 songs hon.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{518400}{6 \times 6} = \dfrac{518400}{36} = 14400 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Part (i) ke jawab se har list ki \(3!\) tarteebein hata dein to yahi jawab milta hai. Is tarah dono parts aapas mein bhi check ho gaye.
